correctness.rationale: An induced independence number for a v-free subset is sum_i max(e_i,epsilon_i), while adjoining v takes the maximum with 1+sum epsilon_i. Matching v-free S to S+v whenever legal leaves exactly k-1 selected middle vertices and local endpoint states 0,a,c. The subsequent earliest a_i toggle removes all residual faces except one critical 0-cell and C(m,k-1) critical (2k-3)-cells. The directed-Hasse acyclicity proof controls arrows across v and B strata and inside each selected-middle-index block: c-states cannot grow and the first non-c a-toggle has one-way orientation. This is an all-m,k proof of the integral wedge by Forman. I inspected the independent induced-subgraph DP and complete Hasse sort in verify.py, and the recorded 30 finite cases including m=6,k=6 have expected critical counts; those tests are not the infinite proof.
